projects.title: OmniRAG
projects.description: OmniRAG is a decentralized RAG architecture leveraging local LLM inference via Ollama. It orchestrates asynchronous web-scraping, session-isolated vector persistence, and real-time knowledge synthesis, all visualized through an immersive, React-driven semantic graph providing high-fidelity technical insights.

projects.title: Rebalance-AI
projects.description: An end-to-end MLOps platform leveraging distributed orchestration, experiment tracking, and containerized microservices to deliver real-time demand forecasting for Boston's Bluebikes network. The system implements a multi-algorithm ensemble architecture with automated hyperparameter tuning.

projects.title: SwarmCoordinator
projects.description: Distributed drone swarm coordination system with Raft consensus for fault tolerance, FastAPI backend with physics simulation, and real-time 3D visualization using Three.js. Features leader election, formation control, collision avoidance via Artificial Potential Fields, WebSocket streaming at 10Hz, and comprehensive REST API with automated deployment.

projects.title: Lucera
projects.description: High-fidelity video pipeline combining Real-ESRGAN upscaling, RIFE interpolation, and Whisper captioning. Features OpenCV analysis, adaptive HLS packaging, and VMAF verification for automated, production-grade enhancement.

projects.title: HawkEye
projects.description: HawkEye is a system for multi-sensor fusion object detection, designed to improve target detection reliability in low-visibility environments (fog, smoke, night vision) using combined RGB, Thermal, and LiDAR data.

projects.title: EcoStockAI
projects.description: ML-driven inventory system: sklearn stockout forecasting, Evidently AI drift detection, Airflow-orchestrated retraining with MLflow RMSE gating. FastAPI · React · PostgreSQL · Docker.

projects.title: NeuroPilot
projects.description: A comparative reinforcement learning framework evaluating Q-Learning versus Deep Q-Networks (DQN) on the Gymnasium CarRacing-v3 environment. The system implements both tabular Q-learning with discretized state spaces and a CNN-based DQN architecture with experience replay and target networks, enabling autonomous agents to learn optimal racing policies.

projects.title: JobHuntr
projects.description: A comprehensive tool to automate your job search for 2026/2027 internships and new grad roles. It scrapes job boards (GitHub, etc.), filters for your keywords, and provides a Kanban board to track your applications.

projects.title: Kernal-Combat
projects.description: Kernal-Combat is a terminal-themed coding arena built with vanilla JS and CodeMirror. Users can solve algorithmic challenges, compare solutions, and trigger automated "combat" where code metrics (runtime, space usage, LOC, solve speed) determine the winner.

projects.title: PranavViswanathanWebsite
projects.description: A sleek, interactive terminal-themed portfolio website showcasing my projects, skills, and experience as a Software Developer & ML Engineer.

projects.title: Regex-LogFile-Searching
projects.description: A program which is used to check for warnings in a sample log file.

projects.title: Image Manipulation Toolkit
projects.description: A comprehensive image processing toolkit built in Java featuring both CLI and GUI interfaces. Implements custom algorithms for RGB channel decomposition, histogram generation with auto color-correction, Haar wavelet compression, split-view transformations, levels adjustment, and region-based masking operations using MVC architecture.
